**In one line**: China's DeepSeek has released a new vision-capable AI model, reportedly claiming it rivals Anthropic's top-tier model.

### Key points
- DeepSeek unveiled a vision-enabled (multimodal) model that processes images alongside text.
- The company is reported to claim the model matches the performance of Anthropic's flagship-tier model.
- Known for its low-cost, open approach, DeepSeek is extending its competition into the multimodal arena.

### Why it matters
The performance claim still awaits independent verification, but if it holds, it signals that the gap between leading U.S. labs and Chinese open models is narrowing in multimodal capabilities too. Cost-to-performance is likely to be the decisive factor.
